scoring_protocol.metric: qa_lab.metrics SQuAD-style normalized EM/token F1, exact NO_ANSWER; format validity reported separately. Not official SQuAD script.
scoring_protocol.primary: mean across seeds gated_kd minus gold overall EM; full_kd secondary, cannot replace primary
scoring_protocol.confidence: 95% percentile paired article-cluster bootstrap on per-question seed-mean paired differences, question-weighted across resampled articles. Captures cohort/article sampling, not full training-seed uncertainty.
scoring_protocol.acceptance: All: gain>=0.03; bootstrap lower>0; >=2 seeds gain>0; answerable and unanswerable mean drops<=0.02; each candidate seed format_valid_rate>=0.99. No rounding before decisions.

bootstrap_method.estimand: question-weighted EM difference, averaged over the fixed three training seeds
bootstrap_method.resampling: sample n_articles articles with replacement; retain every sampled article's questions and all paired seed scores

limitations: Arithmetic scoring does not establish prediction-lock timing or label concealment; verify the execution receipts separately.
The interval conditions on three fixed training seeds and does not estimate full training-seed uncertainty.
Contexts are newly held out within previously used articles; this is not unseen-topic confirmation.
Public SQuAD may occur in pretraining; unseen local context does not establish no pretraining contamination.
Teacher gating changes both target selection and total KL weight; this study does not separate their causal effects.
full_kd is secondary descriptive reporting and cannot replace the preregistered primary candidate.
